channels.name: Company financial filings
channels.use: Earnings, book value, capital, cash flow, dividends and company risks. This readable EBL quarterly report is one example; use each issuer’s own filing.
channels.access: EBL PDF read: 18 pages, unaudited FY2082/83 Q4. Selected issuer reports already admitted; universal automatic filing extraction is not connected.
channels.limits: A quarterly profit is not sustainable earnings. Publication availability, reporting basis and unit normalization must be retained.

channels.name: Nepal Rastra Bank
channels.use: Bank and microfinance credit quality, capital and regulatory context. Follow NRB’s circulars and macroeconomic reports for policy and liquidity context.
channels.cadence: Quarterly indicators; policy and macro publications on their own dates
channels.access: Archive read: Mid-July 2026 bank indicators published 17 September 2026. Reviewed July extraction already connected; automatic refresh remains blocked.
channels.limits: Regulatory and issuer accounting definitions may differ. A new retrieval date does not make the July period current.

channels.name: SEBON
channels.use: Regulatory notices, prospectuses and disclosure context. Verify issue details, effective dates and corporate actions from the actual notice.
channels.access: Homepage and notice/prospectus links read. Automatic event extraction is not connected.
channels.limits: Draft rules are proposals, not enacted requirements. No headline alone creates an adjusted-price factor.

channels.name: Nepal Electricity Authority
channels.use: Hydropower generation, transmission and power-system context; a starting point for PPA/project investigation.
channels.access: 2025/2026 annual-report page and its download link read. Automatic plant/company extraction is not connected.
channels.limits: NEA-wide performance is not a listed hydropower company’s cash flow. Company PPA, generation, debt, project life and costs still need primary evidence.

channels.name: ShareSansar news and announcements
channels.use: Discover shutdowns, repairs, AGMs, dividend notices, rights and filing updates. Follow the announcement archive as well.
channels.access: Latest and announcement pages read; one company news article entered in the manual journal. No automated news or financial feed.
channels.limits: Corroborate material claims with the issuer or regulator. News updates the research agenda; it cannot provide a reliable tomorrow-price prediction.
